'''Pedric Tosh''' was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] eponymous [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="Insider" /> He<ref name="FB" /> carried a [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistol]], and wore the typical Palace Guard [[uniform]].<ref name="Insider" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pedric Tosh was portrayed by an actor onset for [[2002]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> though it is difficult to tell if the character appears in the film itself.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> For that reason, this article treats the [[2005]] ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'' as the first licensed ''[[Star Wars]]'' product that features the character.<ref name="Dressing" /> Tosh's name was revealed in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature of [[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]], released in [[2013]].<ref name="Insider" /> [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]], and [[Sander de Lange]], who contributed to the article, envisioned him as the uncle of [[Jann Tosh]], a character from the TV series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]''. Further speculation was made from the authors about Tosh being one of the Palace Guards killed in the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|explosion]]<ref name="FB" /> of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]]. Because it is unclear if the extra portraying Pedric Tosh is visible at all in ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="Episode II" /> this article makes no assumption about the exact [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Palace Guard's service.
